decisions.statement: The processor seconds a change is allowed are read off that change's own page.
A change stating no seconds is allowed the seconds this module names.
A change stating seconds that are no number above nothing is allowed the same.
The seconds are counted on the processor rather than on the wall clock.
What a change spent counts the processor time of the runs that change reached.
A change at its seconds exactly is passed over.
What is said names the change, the seconds spent and the seconds allowed.
What is said sends a ceiling that wants raising to Alan.
A change is run here rather than timed by whoever calls that change.
A change past its seconds runs to its end and then answers no edit.
The megabytes a change is allowed are read off that change's own page.
A change stating no megabytes is held to none.
A change stating megabytes that are no number above nothing is held to none.
A change stating megabytes is held in a group of its own for as long as that change runs.
A change is let out of that group whether that change answered or raised.
A change past its megabytes is reclaimed and slowed rather than ended.
What that reclaim costs is counted in the processor seconds the change spent.
Nothing refuses a change for the memory that change held.

definition: the processor seconds and the megabytes one change is allowed, and what a change past them is told
